title: Eval alert provenance, autogenerated runbook, and noise-silencer in Console
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Ops and product teams are getting noisy eval regression alerts after model/config rollouts. Alerts lack clear provenance (which config or model change caused the delta), suggested triage steps, and strong dedupe heuristics across channels (Slack threads, PagerDuty incidents, and in-Console notifications). Goal: Build an end-to-end feature that (1) surfaces alert provenance (linking an eval regression to the exact config/model/version and rollout window), (2) injects an autogenerated runbook / triage checklist into the Console alert card and Slack/PagerDuty payloads, and (3) implements an adaptive noise-silencer that suppresses duplicate or low-confidence alerts across channels while preserving SLO-driven escalations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console eval-alert card shows linked change provenance (model id + version + rollout ID + commit link) and time window. 2) Autogenerated runbook appears in Console and in Slack/PagerDuty alerts with step-by-step triage actions and relevant dashboards/PR links. 3) Alerts dedupe across channels: duplicate signatures within 30m are grouped; low-confidence flakiness alerts are auto-muted if confidence < 0.6 and seen in >=3 runs with high variance. 4) PagerDuty payload includes escalation hint and runbook link; Slack message includes a thread starter and 'Mark as noise' action. 5) Metric targets: reduce ops alert volume by 35% for eval-related regressions during canary periods; median time-to-first-ack improves by 20% in pilot orgs.
non_goals: 1) This ticket does not change core eval scoring algorithms. 2) Not building new model-based root-cause analysis (RCA) — only deterministic provenance and templated runbooks. 3) No changes to billing or quota enforcement.
implementation_notes: - Build provenance extractor in the change-event service that joins rollout metadata, model catalog entries, and eval snapshot IDs. - Console: new alert-card UI with expandable 'Provenance & Runbook' pane; API returns structured strings (flat fields) for alerting integrations. - Alerting adapter: augment Slack block and PagerDuty event with runbook text and dedupe signature. - Noise-silencer: rule engine with configurable thresholds (confidence, recurrence, timespan) and a sticky mute labeling in Console. - Logging: every suppression must emit an audit-event with reason and source to customer audit logs.
acceptance_test_plan: 1) Unit tests for provenance extractor joining model_version -> rollout -> eval_snapshot. 2) E2E test: simulate a canary rollout that triggers eval delta; assert Console card includes correct provenance links and runbook steps. 3) Integration test: simulated repeated flakey deltas; verify noise-silencer groups alerts and Slack thread shows single message. 4) PagerDuty test org: ensure incident payload contains runbook link and escalation hint. 5) Pilot with two internal customers for 2 weeks; collect alert volume and MTTA metrics.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-suppressing alerts could hide real regressions. Mitigation: default conservative thresholds; require explicit customer opt-in for aggressive muting. Risk: Runbook could contain stale links. Mitigation: include snapshoted links (eval snapshot, committed rollout ID) not mutable paths. Risk: PagerDuty schema limits payload size. Mitigation: include short summary + link to Console runbook instead of full text when over threshold.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): Feature flags for provenance extractor and runbook blocks; internal pilot in staging. Phase 2 (alpha): Offer to 3 early-access customers with opt-in toggle in Console - 'Auto-runbook & noise-silencer'. Phase 3 (general): Default on for orgs with >= 10k evals/month; admin toggle for muting aggressiveness.
metrics: - Eval-alerts-per-org/week (target -35% during canary rollouts). - Median MTTA (time to ack) reduction target -20%. - False-suppression rate < 2% (tracked by manual unmute events). - PagerDuty incident creation reduction (duplicate incidents deduped) target -30%.
